method: Playwright chromium spec tests/e2e/audit-C-vps-2026-07-21.spec.js (PLAYWRIGHT_NO_WEB_SERVER=1), 7 screenshots read with vision + per-scenario console/network/pageerror sinks + raw-i18n/NaN text scans. Login diagnosed additionally via direct curl to /api/auth/login.
headline: Deploy is REACHABLE and the deployed FRONTEND BUNDLE is HEALTHY (login page, error UX, OSS public board, auth-guard redirect all render clean, on-brand, zero JS errors, zero raw i18n keys). BUT the VPS staging box is NOT SEEDED: documented staff credentials (123456) are rejected and the kiosk machine is not provisioned. This BLOCKS validation of 4 of 5 requested surfaces (catalog-hub fusion, stock photo, POS composer wizard, KDS). The caisse composer-aware wizard was NOT tested and is NOT attested.

findings.surface: Admin + Caisse + KDS login (/api/auth/login) on VPS
findings.title: Documented staff credentials (password 123456) rejected on VPS — blocks ALL authenticated deploy-validation surfaces
findings.evidence: In-browser (Playwright) POST /api/auth/login → HTTP 400 {"errors":{"validation":"Identifiants invalides ou compte bloqué"}} for admin@lecayenne.fr, admin@example.com AND pos@lecayenne.fr. Confirmed independently via curl. NOT a lockout: response carries X-RateLimit-Limit:10 / X-RateLimit-Remaining:9 on first attempts (a 429 only appears AFTER ~10 cross-test retries). A nonexistent account returns the SAME generic message (correct anti-enumeration). The api-key gate itself PASSES (see P2) — so the rejection is genuinely bad credentials, i.e. the demo accounts are not seeded / carry a different password on this box. Screenshots: s0-login-after-attempt.png (red banner 'Identifiants invalides ou compte bloqué'), s2-catalog-hub-blocked.png / s4-pos-blocked.png / s5-kds.png (all byte-identical clean /login redirect).
findings.reproduction: curl -sk -X POST https://vps-418872ac.vps.ovh.net/api/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'x-api-key: change-me-long-random-string-local-dev' -d '{"email":"admin@lecayenne.fr","password":"123456"}' → HTTP 400 bad-creds. Fix: seed the demo accounts on the VPS (php artisan foodking:ensure-admin / ensure-pos-operator ...) or supply the real staging password, then re-run Wave C to validate catalog-hub / stock photo / POS wizard / KDS.
findings.impact: No staff can log into admin, caisse, or KDS on the VPS with the documented credentials. Deploy-validation of every authenticated surface is blocked. This is an environment/seed gap (consistent with a fresh staging deploy), NOT an application-code defect — the login form + error handling render correctly.

findings.title: Kiosk idle attract screen UNREACHABLE on VPS — kiosk machine not provisioned server-side (redirects to /kiosk/login fallback)
findings.evidence: GET /kiosk/idle redirects to /kiosk/login. Screenshot s1-kiosk-idle.png shows a clean, on-brand fallback card: 'Borne de commande — CONNEXION AUTOMATIQUE', 'Connexion machine non configurée côté serveur.', red banner 'Borne momentanément indisponible. Merci de passer commande en caisse. 🙏', 'Réessayer' CTA (brand orange). No raw i18n key, no NaN, no layout break, zero console/page errors. The requested idle attract screen (branding + start-order CTA) therefore never renders — the KioskMachine is not seeded on this box.
findings.reproduction: Open https://vps-418872ac.vps.ovh.net/kiosk/idle → lands on /kiosk/login 'non configurée'. Fix: provision/pair the kiosk machine on the VPS (KioskMachineTableSeeder), then re-capture /kiosk/idle.
findings.impact: Customer-facing kiosk surface is non-functional on the VPS until provisioned. Degradation is GRACEFUL and well-designed (no visual defect) — severity is P2 because it is a seed/infra gap, not a broken component, but it does prevent validating the kiosk idle scenario.

findings.surface: All SPA pages (window.foodkingConfig served in master.blade.php)
findings.title: Default/placeholder API key served in production HTML: apiKey = 'change-me-long-random-string-local-dev'
findings.evidence: Served HTML (curl https://vps-418872ac.vps.ovh.net/login) contains: window.foodkingConfig = { apiKey: "change-me-long-random-string-local-dev", ... } (from config('app.api_key'), master.blade.php:147-149). This value PASSES the backend api-key gate (login with it returns bad-creds, not 'Clé API invalide'), proving the deployed APP_API_KEY is literally the placeholder default. The key is world-readable in page source and grants the api-key-gated surface to any client (a public token faucet, mirrors prior HANDOVER_SECRETS_REGISTRY concern).
findings.reproduction: curl -sk https://vps-418872ac.vps.ovh.net/login | grep -o 'apiKey[^,}]*' → apiKey: "change-me-long-random-string-local-dev". Fix: set a strong APP_API_KEY in the VPS .env, config:cache, redeploy; rotate on both ends.
findings.impact: Weak/guessable shared secret in a public-facing environment. Owner-gated go-live item (rotate before production). Not a blocker for staging function, but should not ship to prod.

findings.title: Repeated failed logins eventually 429 (rate-limit works) — informational, confirms throttle is live
findings.evidence: After ~10 failed login POSTs across the 5 tests, one response returned HTTP 429 Too Many Requests (s5_kds_oss sink). Early attempts were 400 bad-creds with X-RateLimit-Remaining:9, confirming the throttle:login-lockout defence is active and correctly ordered AFTER the api-key gate. No app defect — recorded so the P1 credential failure is not misread as pure rate-limiting.
findings.reproduction: Send >10 POST /api/auth/login in a short window → 429. Expected, defensive behaviour.

coverage.S1_kiosk_idle: DEGRADED — kiosk not provisioned; captured the /kiosk/login 'non configurée' fallback (clean, on-brand). Idle attract screen not verifiable as specified. See P2.
coverage.S2_admin_catalog_hub_2_tabs: LOGIN-BLOCKED (infra) — not verified. Bounced to /login. The new Catalogue+Stock fusion tabs could not be exercised.
coverage.S3_stock_photo_button: LOGIN-BLOCKED (infra) — not verified. (Local source confirms selectors exist: stock-mgmt-photo-btn-* → stock-mgmt-photo-panel-* with ItemPhotoUpload drag-drop, but the LIVE VPS render was unreachable.)
coverage.S4_pos_composer_wizard: LOGIN-BLOCKED (infra) — NOT TESTED. Could not reach /admin/pos authenticated. The composer-aware caisse wizard was NOT opened and its clean-open is NOT attested.
coverage.S5_KDS: LOGIN-BLOCKED (infra) — not verified; /kds redirects to /login (auth guard correct).
coverage.S5_OSS: CAPTURED + HEALTHY — /admin/order-status-screen is a PUBLIC display, rendered without login. Two columns 'En préparation' (magenta) / 'Prêt' (green), coherent empty state, no raw i18n key, no NaN, no layout break. s5-oss.png.
coverage.S0_login_bonus: CAPTURED + HEALTHY — login page + error UX render clean and on-brand (Le Cayenne logo, 'Bon Retour', Connexion CTA, dismissible error banner). s0-login-page.png, s0-login-after-attempt.png.

positive_attestations: Deployed frontend bundle is sound: zero uncaught page errors (pageerror) on ANY surface.
Zero raw i18n keys and zero NaN/undefined leaked in any captured surface (all text scans clean).
Auth guard works: unauthenticated /admin/catalog-hub, /admin/pos, /kds all redirect to a clean /login.
OSS public board + login page + kiosk-unconfigured fallback are all on-brand and visually intact.
Only 4xx/5xx observed were the expected login 400/429 — no vendor/Vue console errors.
